title: FairyCoinPlugin
description: The mod introduces a variety of currencies into the game, which can be converted from one to another using right-click (RCM).
body:
The mod introduces a variety of currencies into the game, which can be converted from one to another using right-click (RCM). For instance, holding "Gold ingot" can be converted into ten individual "Gold nugget" items. If you're holding 12 "Gold ingot" items, right-clicking will transform them into one "Gold block" item and tree "Gold ingot".

Additionally, the mod adds drops of "Gold ingot", "Iron ingot", and "Copper ingot" from all vanilla mobs.

A gacha machine is introduced, offering random loot in exchange for currency. The machine can be activated with a right-click when holding " Gold block", "Iron block", or "Copper block".

 

This plugin serves as an alternative to the Fairy Coin mod. To add custom models, you can download the FairyCoinPack.
